The booking sites at Orlando hotels

60 sites, 11 of them at one hotel only. Most hotels listed: Hotels In America at 15, Priceline at 14, Booking.com at 13, Hotels.com at 12 and the hotel's own site at 12. Fewest sites: Hilton Garden Inn Orlando I-4 Millenia Blvd Mall (6); most: Wyndham I-Drive Avanti Resort & Conference Center (28, as were 2 others).

Hotels In America was lowest at Staybridge Suites Orlando at Seaworld by IHG, Hilton Garden Inn Orlando I-4 Millenia Blvd Mall and Renaissance Orlando at SeaWorld® of its 15, and 5%+ above another site at 10. Priceline was lowest at none of its 14, and 5%+ above another site at 14. Booking.com was lowest at none of its 13, and 5%+ above another site at 13.

The hotel's own site, at 12 of the 15: lowest at none, a median 25% above the lowest site. Nearest: Westgate Lakes Resort & Spa, $132 against $130 on Reservation Day. Farthest: Rosen Plaza Hotel, $135 against $90 on KAYAK.com.

Lowest at 5%+ below the going rate: Super.com at 6, KAYAK.com at 3, Etrip.net at 2, Hotels In America at 2, Hotelscombined.com at 2, Vio.com at 2, goseek.com at 1, Kiwi.com at 1 and Reservation Day at 1 (ties count for each). All cities: which booking site was lowest most often.

A lower price may be a smaller room or a non-refundable rate. Up to 28 listings were kept per hotel.

Taxes, fees and resort fees in Orlando

They added a median of 12.6% ($16 a night) to the before-tax going rate. It was 12.0% to 13.4% at all 12 hotels, from DASKK Orlando Hotel near Universal Blvd, an Ascend Collection Hotel to Hyatt Regency Orlando: no flat nightly fee on top. Whether a resort fee was inside the before-tax price, our data cannot tell. The 3 listed prices may leave out resort or property fees. More: do resort fees show in the price?

Orlando, priced again a week later

Same stay, same Orlando hotels, 7 days apart, before tax; up and down mean more than 2%. Each stay links its CSV.

  • Oct 13 to Oct 15 stay, Sep 22 then Sep 29: 4 up, 3 down of 8; rose most Marriott's Grande Vista, $108 to $160; fell most CoCo Key Resort and Water Park Orlando, $168 to $134; another site lowest at 5.
  • Oct 30 to Nov 1 stay, Sep 25 then Oct 2: 5 up, 5 down of 15; rose most DoubleTree by Hilton Orlando Theme Park Resort, $92 to $104; fell most Westgate Lakes Resort & Spa, $143 to $120; another site lowest at 12.

One week is no rule for when to book.

Questions about Orlando hotel prices

How much is a hotel in Orlando?

$145 a night all-in at the median (Sep 25, 2026 prices), from $71 at DASKK Orlando Hotel near Universal Blvd, an Ascend Collection Hotel to $243 at Hyatt Regency Orlando.

Do Orlando hotel prices include resort fees?

Our data cannot show a resort fee by itself. It was 12.0% to 13.4% at all 12 hotels, from DASKK Orlando Hotel near Universal Blvd, an Ascend Collection Hotel to Hyatt Regency Orlando: no flat nightly fee on top. Whether a resort fee was inside the before-tax price, our data cannot tell.

Does our data show the cheapest time to book a hotel in Orlando?

No: these prices come from a few Orlando dates, not a season. Sep 25 to Oct 2: 5 Orlando hotels rose more than 2%, 5 fell; DoubleTree by Hilton Orlando Theme Park Resort rose most, $92 to $104 before tax.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Orlando hotels?

Below the going rate, most often Super.com (6 hotels) and KAYAK.com (3 hotels). The hotel's own site: lowest at none of 12.

How we measured this

The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price). The study's method. Words last changed November 23, 2026; prices read September 25, 2026; each hotel's page has every site's price in the newest snapshot that priced it.

Nearest medians to Orlando's: New Orleans $143, Fort Lauderdale $112, Paris $105, New York $191.
